title: Penguin with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='32' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='18' ry='24' fill='#dce8f7'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='20' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#dce8f7'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#1a1e33'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='29' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='31.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='28' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#1a1e33'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='29' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='31.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='28' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Sparkle stars near eyes -->
  <path d='M36 22 l1.2 2.8 2.8 1.2 -2.8 1.2 -1.2 2.8 -1.2 -2.8 -2.8 -1.2 2.8 -1.2z' fill='#ffe36e'/>
  <path d='M64 22 l1.2 2.8 2.8 1.2 -2.8 1.2 -1.2 2.8 -1.2 -2.8 -2.8 -1.2 2.8 -1.2z' fill='#ffe36e'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d='M45 38 L50 44 L55 38 Z' fill='#f0a030'/>
  <!-- Wings -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='60' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#2b3854' transform='rotate(15 22 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='60' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#2b3854' transform='rotate(-15 78 60)'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='94' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#f0a030'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#f0a030'/>
</svg>
